video.title: Mountain Weather Update 11/5, Meteorologist Chris Tomer

description:
Atmospheric River setup for PNW/BC through 11/16.  High elevation rain/snow line with moderate to heavy to snow accumulation at mid-mountain and higher (biggest totals at peak-level).  
Changes from yesterday, now pattern might NOT break to the south until on/after 11/16.  It's a waiting game for the Intermountain West.
